brief.scope: Independently review GPT-6 C1 contract changes against Grok ruling 518ab8 and owner brief. Only dispatch/CONTRACT.md and task/CONTRACT.md plus necessary owning seams. Verify one target execution authority with existing frontends, current-versus-proposed distinction, independent configurable harness/model/role/profile, launch/task output ownership, one semantic envelope authority, narrow inline workaround, preserved fileset refusal and honest per-harness capability evidence. Policy is a consume-only join; permanent dev tooling must not depend on or be replaced by Symfony. No extra roadmap, copied policy, dormant-feature obligation or current-runtime claim. Check precise testable next obligations, internal consistency and changed links. Return concise approve/changes, material gaps only with reproduction and smallest correction. Read-only: no source/tests/settings/host/DB/network edits or vendor launches.

findings.claim: The change rewrote the `caps` refusal owner from "`run.py`'s own text" to "the launch preflight's own text" under a table header it also rewrote to read "Current dispatch refusal exit: 3". launch.py has no caps preflight: there is no `_refuse("caps"` anywhere in it, no `cap`/`total`/`cap_out`/`out` wire parsing, and its only cap input is `--cap-out` on resume (line 2093), assigned at 1759 with no validation. The text quoted by the row lives only in `run.py::_breaker_argv` (lines 428-434, `RunError`) - the same vendor engine this change classifies as manual/dormant and "not a proven backend". So a row presented as current dispatch behavior names a producer that does not exist, in a change whose stated discipline is separating measured behavior from proposals. Smallest correction: restore the measured attribution and mark the row proposed, e.g. "| `caps` | ... | proposed; launch has no caps preflight, the text is `run.py::_breaker_argv`'s, on the dormant path |".
findings.reproduce: grep -c '_refuse("caps"' ops/devlane/dispatch/launch.py; grep -n 'caps' ops/devlane/dispatch/launch.py; sed -n '426,436p' ops/devlane/task/run.py; sed -n '337p' ops/devlane/dispatch/CONTRACT.md

findings.claim: The stamped baseline evidence is written with a moving ref: `git diff e59a52bce37dbd1fed52d358b655bae00267f71f HEAD --name-only -- ops/devlane ops/bin ops/conductor/tools ops/process` is stated to have "returned no paths". That holds at the stamped ref 2b0491203cb9b37459fb2af6ac703940051374d2, but the command as printed, run in the tree that carries the claim, returns ops/devlane/dispatch/CONTRACT.md and ops/devlane/task/CONTRACT.md - the change's own two files. The reproduction contradicts its own stated result on first re-run. Smallest correction: replace `HEAD` in the printed command with the literal `2b0491203cb9b37459fb2af6ac703940051374d2`.
findings.reproduce: git diff e59a52bce37dbd1fed52d358b655bae00267f71f 2b0491203cb9b37459fb2af6ac703940051374d2 --name-only -- ops/devlane ops/bin ops/conductor/tools ops/process; git diff e59a52bce37dbd1fed52d358b655bae00267f71f HEAD --name-only -- ops/devlane ops/bin ops/conductor/tools ops/process

findings.claim: The target says "task owns output requirements in jobs.json" and "launch resolves declared `{out}` paths into grants", and the ruling's C1 scope is "job output grants derived from jobs.json declared {out} paths". But no jobs.json entry has an outputs field: `{out}/PLAN.md`, `{out}/SKEPTIC.md` and `{out}/RULING.md` occur only as free prose inside `prompt` (and `deliverable`) strings. The contract names no field, no extraction rule and no refusal class for an undeclarable or unsupported output, so the next independent test author has no declared surface to assert grant derivation against and must invent the declaration mechanism the contract was supposed to fix. Smallest correction: add one sentence naming where the declaration lives for the next slice - either "grants are derived from `{out}/...` occurrences in the job's rendered prompt" as the measured interim rule, or "a later slice adds a jobs.json `outputs` list; until it lands there is no machine-readable declaration".
findings.reproduce: grep -n 'PLAN.md\|SKEPTIC.md\|RULING.md' ops/devlane/task/jobs.json; grep -c '"outputs"' ops/devlane/task/jobs.json; sed -n '222,238p' ops/devlane/task/CONTRACT.md
